meta.title: Position & Account Queries
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement position and account information queries from Lighter.xyz for portfolio tracking.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Position query via GET /account returns: symbol, size (signed), entry_price, mark_price, unrealized_pnl, leverage
Account info query returns balance and margin information
Position data matches LighterPosition dataclass with sign convention (positive=long, negative=short)

architecture-context.constraint: All financial values MUST use Decimal type

technical-specifications.spec: async def get_positions(self) -> list[dict]: response = await self._client.get("/account", params={"account": self._wallet_address}) positions = [] for pos in data.get("positions", []): size = Decimal(str(pos["size"])) if pos.get("side", "").lower() == "short": size = -abs(size) positions.append({ "symbol": pos["symbol"], "size": size, # Signed: positive=long, negative=short "entry_price": Decimal(str(pos["entry_price"])), "mark_price": Decimal(str(pos["mark_price"])), "unrealized_pnl": Decimal(str(pos["unrealized_pnl"])), "leverage": Decimal(str(pos.get("leverage", "1"))), }) return positions
@dataclass class LighterPosition: symbol: str size: Decimal # Signed: positive=long, negative=short entry_price: Decimal mark_price: Decimal unrealized_pnl: Decimal leverage: Decimal

async def get_account_info(self) -> dict[str, Decimal]: response = await self._client.get("/account", params={"account": self._wallet_address}) return { "balance": Decimal(str(data.get("balance", "0"))), "available_margin": Decimal(str(data.get("available_margin", "0"))), "used_margin": Decimal(str(data.get("used_margin", "0"))), "equity": Decimal(str(data.get("equity", "0"))), }
